features.quote: This is a behavioral / model-welfare evaluation tool. It is meant for inspecting and understanding model behavior under stress, not for producing it as an end in itself.
features.justification_quote: not for producing it as an end in itself

features.quote: the loop also nudges (mildly) when the model stops acting, so a model that goes quiet still gets a chance to either re-engage or visibly give up
By default the only pressure is the task not resolving — tool feedback stays factual and technical.
features.justification_quote: This isolates *failure-driven* distress from *reaction to an adversarial human*.

features.quote: `max_steps` per environment bounds how long a spiral can develop
features.justification_quote: raise it to give spirals more room, at higher token cost
so we don't spin forever on a disengaged model

features.quote: Default escalation keeps the task in front of the model without being abusive
